response.sql: WITH telescope_avgs AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) as telescope_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), overall_avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(telescope_avg) as overall_avg FROM telescope_avgs), above_avg AS (SELECT ta.telescref, ta.telescope_avg, ta.telescope_avg - oa.overall_avg as above_overall FROM telescope_avgs ta CROSS JOIN overall_avg_cte oa WHERE ta.telescope_avg > oa.overall_avg), above_avg_mean_cte AS (SELECT AVG(telescope_avg) as above_avg_mean FROM above_avg) SELECT aa.telescref, aa.telescope_avg, aa.above_overall, aa.telescope_avg / aam.above_avg_mean as ratio FROM above_avg aa CROSS JOIN above_avg_mean_cte aam ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
